title: 2002 AMC 8 Problem 18
statement: Gage skated \(1\) hr \(15\) min each day for \(5\) days and \(1\) hr \(30\) min each day for \(3\) days. How long would he have to skate the ninth day in order to average \(85\) minutes of skating each day for the entire time?

solutions.text:
Gage has skated a total of \[ 5 \cdot 75 + 3 \cdot 90 = 645 \] minutes.

For an average of \(85\) minutes over \(9\) days, Gage must have skated a total of \[ 85 \cdot 9 = 765 \] minutes.

This means that Gage must skate \[ 765 - 645 = 120 \] minutes on the last day. Note that \(120\) minutes is the same as \(2\) hours.

Thus, E is the correct answer.
hints: Convert all skating times to minutes.
Find the total minutes needed for a \(9\)-day average of \(85.\)
